_설명: 천일문 3권 Chapter 11 일치와 화법에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 은행에서는 심화 11과 일치와 화법 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: 부분을 나타내는 말(half of, a third of…)의 수일치
a number of(복수) vs. the number of(단수)

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: Every ticket were sold out in an hour.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: The rich is expected to help others.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 화법 전환이 바르지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: The man said to me, “Open the window.” → The man told me to open the window.
She said, “I am going to the library now.” → She said she was going to the library then.
The clerk said to me, “Do you like these bags?” → The clerk asked me if I liked those bags.
Lucas said to his mother, “I will be back by six.” → Lucas told his mother he will be back by six.
Ashley said to her brother, “I want to go with you.” → Ashley told her brother she wanted to go with him.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 화법 전환이 바르지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: I said to the boy, “Can you help me?” → I asked the boy if he could help me.
Dad said to me, “Never give up.” → Dad advised me never to give up.
Mina said out loud, “I know the answer!” → Mina said out loud that I knew the answer.
Mr. Brown said to me, “You need more rest.” → Mr. Brown told me I needed more rest.
The teacher said to me, “Why were you late yesterday?” → The teacher asked me why I had been late the previous day.

questions.answer: A number of students are watching

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 우유의 3분의 1이 바닥에 엎질러졌다. (the milk, a third, be, spill, of)
questions.answer: A third of the milk was spilled[spilt]

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 우리는 지구가 태양 주위를 돈다는 것을 배웠다. (learn, the Earth, that, go around)

questions.prompt: 다음 글의 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ, ⓓ를 어법상 알맞은 형태로 쓰세요.
body: Japan ⓐ [[have]] interesting history and culture. Many people know that this country ⓑ [[be]] visited by many tourists every year. Today, about two-thirds of its land ⓒ [[be]] covered with mountains. Also, a number of Japanese ⓓ [[be]] proud of their food culture.
